name: 2-3 Swap Compositing
definition: A modified version of binary swap implemented by Yu et al. to overcome the limitation that the number of processors had to be a power of two.
summary: 2-3 Swap Compositing is a parallel algorithm that composites image tiles from an arbitrary number of processors using a binary-ternary tree, avoiding the power-of-two restriction of standard binary swap while limiting communication to four neighbors per stage.
